def: to exercise self-restraint (in diet and chastity)

occurrences.text: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
